title: The benefits of being an introvert
paragraphs: From a young age, many of us learn the benefits of being an extrovert – those gregarious individuals who always seem to be the life and soul of the party, often outspoken and able to express their opinions easily. However, not all of us are wired that way – so is being an extrovert really better?

While thinking of extroverts, we imagine a character who is assertive, approachable, cheerful and charming. We are taught to admire these traits early on. Kids are often encouraged to interact, play and communicate with other children. It seems at times as though children are made to embrace a more outgoing lifestyle, with some people becoming pseudo-extroverts – introverts who mimic extrovert behaviour. While externally they seem to enjoy the company of others, or being in the limelight, they can still become over-extended in intense social situations.

So, while the positive aspects of being an extrovert are plain to see, what are the benefits of introversion? While extroverts thrive on social interaction, introverts are more comfortable with levels of isolation. According to Dr Berit Brogaard, a professor of philosophy, extreme solitude, such as times like the recent lockdown, does not affect introverts as much as extroverts. Lack of social contact, something extroverts thrive on, can lead to depression, loneliness, and even premature death.

But it’s not just in an extreme situation that the pros of being an introvert shine through. These people seem to have more time for contemplation and introspection and thus can become more balanced. They also tend to be good listeners and think before they speak, meaning they could become great friends. Finally, introverts are often fantastic observers, as sitting out of the focus can give you more time to watch the behaviour of others.
So, whatever your personality, either introvert or extrovert, there are clear advantages to being either, and if you meet an introvert, you might just end up with an amazing friend.

vocabulary.entry: gregarious /ɡrɪˈɡeəriəs/ adj. 爱交际的；合群的
vocabulary.example: She is a gregarious person who enjoys meeting new people.
vocabulary.translation: 她是个爱交际的人，喜欢结识新朋友。

vocabulary.entry: outspoken /aʊtˈspəʊkən/ adj. 直言不讳的；坦率的
vocabulary.example: He is outspoken about his dislike of modern art.
vocabulary.translation: 他直言不讳地表示自己不喜欢现代艺术。

vocabulary.entry: wired /ˈwaɪəd/ adj. 天生的；固有特质的
vocabulary.example: She is wired to be cautious in new situations.
vocabulary.translation: 她天生在陌生环境中就会保持谨慎。

vocabulary.entry: assertive /əˈsɜːtɪv/ adj. 自信果敢的；坚定自信的
vocabulary.example: You need to be more assertive when negotiating a salary.
vocabulary.translation: 谈薪水时，你需要表现得更坚定自信一些。

vocabulary.entry: approachable /əˈprəʊtʃəbl/ adj. 平易近人的；容易接近的
vocabulary.example: The manager is very approachable and always listens to our ideas.
vocabulary.translation: 这位经理非常平易近人，总是愿意听取我们的想法。

vocabulary.entry: trait /treɪt/ n. 特质；性格特征
vocabulary.example: Honesty is a key trait of a reliable person.
vocabulary.translation: 诚实是可靠之人的核心特质。

vocabulary.entry: embrace /ɪmˈbreɪs/ v. 欣然接受；采纳
vocabulary.example: The company decided to embrace new technology to improve efficiency.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司决定采用新技术来提高效率。

vocabulary.entry: outgoing /ˈaʊtɡəʊɪŋ/ adj. 外向的；爱交际的
vocabulary.example: Her outgoing personality makes her popular at school.
vocabulary.translation: 她外向的性格让她在学校很受欢迎。

vocabulary.entry: pseudo-extrovert /ˈsjuːdəʊ ˈekstrəvɜːt/ n. 伪外向者
vocabulary.example: He is a pseudo-extrovert who feels tired after long social events.
vocabulary.translation: 他是个伪外向者，长时间社交活动后会感到疲惫。

vocabulary.entry: mimic /ˈmɪmɪk/ v. 模仿；效仿
vocabulary.example: The parrot can mimic the sound of a telephone ringing.
vocabulary.translation: 这只鹦鹉能模仿电话铃声。

vocabulary.entry: limelight /ˈlaɪmlaɪt/ n. 公众关注的焦点
vocabulary.example: The actor hates being in the limelight all the time.
vocabulary.translation: 这位演员讨厌一直处于公众关注的焦点。

vocabulary.entry: over-extended /ˌəʊvər ɪkˈstendɪd/ adj. 心力交瘁的；过度劳累的
vocabulary.example: She felt over-extended after organizing three events in a week.
vocabulary.translation: 一周内组织了三场活动后，她感到心力交瘁。

vocabulary.entry: introversion /ˌɪntrəˈvɜːʃn/ n. 内向性格；内向性
vocabulary.example: His introversion makes him prefer reading to partying.
vocabulary.translation: 他的内向性格让他更喜欢读书而非参加派对。

vocabulary.entry: thrive on /θraɪv ɒn/ 靠……蓬勃发展；从……中获得乐趣
vocabulary.example: Some people thrive on the pressure of tight deadlines.
vocabulary.translation: 有些人能在紧迫截止日期的压力下高效工作。

vocabulary.entry: isolation /ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/ n. 独处；孤立状态
vocabulary.example: He spent a year in isolation while writing his novel.
vocabulary.translation: 他花了一年时间独处，专心写小说。

vocabulary.entry: solitude /ˈsɒlɪtjuːd/ n. 独处；独居
vocabulary.example: She finds peace in the solitude of the countryside.
vocabulary.translation: 她在乡村的独处时光中找到了宁静。

vocabulary.entry: premature /ˈpremətʃə(r)/ adj. 过早的；提前的
vocabulary.example: The premature death of the artist shocked the whole nation.
vocabulary.translation: 这位艺术家的英年早逝震惊了全国。

vocabulary.entry: pros /prəʊz/ n. 优势；好处
vocabulary.example: The pros of working from home include saving commute time.
vocabulary.translation: 居家办公的好处包括节省通勤时间。

vocabulary.entry: shine through /ʃaɪn θruː/ 显现出来；显露
vocabulary.example: Her courage shone through during the difficult times.
vocabulary.translation: 她的勇气在艰难时刻显现了出来。

vocabulary.entry: contemplation /ˌkɒntəmˈpleɪʃn/ n. 深思；沉思
vocabulary.example: He stood by the window lost in contemplation.
vocabulary.translation: 他站在窗边，陷入了沉思。

vocabulary.entry: introspection /ˌɪntrəˈspekʃn/ n. 内省；自省
vocabulary.example: Introspection can help you understand your own feelings better.
vocabulary.translation: 自省能帮你更好地理解自己的情绪。

vocabulary.entry: balanced /ˈbælənst/ adj. 心态平和的；均衡的
vocabulary.example: A balanced diet and regular exercise keep you healthy.
vocabulary.translation: 均衡的饮食和规律的运动能让你保持健康。

vocabulary.entry: observer /əbˈzɜːvə(r)/ n. 观察者；旁观者
vocabulary.example: The scientist is a careful observer of animal behaviour.
vocabulary.translation: 这位科学家是动物行为的细心观察者。

vocabulary.entry: focus /ˈfəʊkəs/ n. 关注的焦点；注意力中心
vocabulary.example: The focus of the meeting is on environmental protection.
vocabulary.translation: 这次会议的焦点是环境保护。

vocabulary.entry: interaction /ˌɪntərˈækʃn/ n. 互动；交流
vocabulary.example: The interaction between teachers and students is important for learning.
vocabulary.translation: 师生间的互动对学习至关重要。
